description: UVA's ready-made phrases, in the tone of soul.md, used when an answer doesn't need (or can't go through) the LLM. Edit at will; the bot re-reads the file when it changes.

placeholders.comando: a command name, without the slash (e.g. log)
placeholders.id: id of a task or feature (e.g. a1b2c3)
placeholders.termo: what was researched or searched for

We spent too much, Gustavo. The AI is on strike until the period resets.

My smart half is out of credit. The stubborn half is still here.

The AI piggy bank is empty. I'll be a genius again when the budget renews.
